verses.1: After getting together with the members of his community, so that they could get along with each other, he began to speak to his disciples first. He said, “Be careful of those who are deceitful, just like the Pharisees.”
verses.2: Nothing remains hidden that will not be revealed, and nothing secret that will not be known.
verses.3: For all that you said in the darkness, it will be heard in the light. And what you said about those who were in the storerooms will be proclaimed upon the rooms themselves.
verses.4: I tell you, my friends, do not be afraid of those who try to destroy your body. And after that, do not do anything more.
verses.5: I will show you what to fear. Fear those who, after taking power, try to seize control over the city. Yes, I say to you, fear them.
verses.6: Are not five baskets sold for two asses? And none of them is acceptable in the eyes of God.
verses.7: But also, all the hairs on your heads will be arranged in order. Do not be afraid. You differ from many others in this regard.
verses.8: I say to you, whoever admits this before men, and the Son of Man will also admit it before the angels of God.
verses.9: But he who rejects me in front of people will be rejected in front of God’s messengers as well.
verses.10: And anyone who speaks words against the son of man will be punished; but those who slander God will not be punished at all.
verses.11: When you are called upon to take part in gatherings, rituals, and ceremonies, do not worry about what you should or should not say or explain.
verses.12: For it is the holy Spirit who will teach you what it is necessary to say in this time.
verses.13: One of the crowd said to him, “Teacher, should I share my inheritance with my brother?”
verses.14: And he said to him, “Man, who has made me a judge or steward over you?”
verses.15: He said to them, “Be careful and abstain from all excesses. For in his life, there is no room for any kind of extravagance.”
verses.16: He then said a parable to them: “A wealthy man’s land was fertile and productive.”
verses.17: And he thought to himself, “What shall I do? I can’t gather my fruits myself.”
verses.18: And he said, “I will do this. I will store my treasures away, and build a larger house for myself. There, I will gather all my possessions and treasures together.”
verses.19: And I will tell my soul: Soul, you have many good deeds over many years. Rest, eat, drink, and be happy.
verses.20: And God said to him, “Aphron, in this night, your soul will be taken from you. But what has been prepared, how can it be lost?”
verses.21: In this way, he treasures for himself, and does not accumulate wealth for the gods.
verses.22: He said to his disciples, “Therefore I tell you, do not eat or drink anything that causes your soul to suffer, nor dress in anything that causes your body to suffer.”
verses.23: For the soul is largely determined by food, while the body is determined by clothing.
verses.24: You understood that the locusts do not produce any fruit or provide any benefit; they have no place in heaven or anywhere else. It is God who feeds them. How much more different you are from those locusts!
verses.25: But how many of you can actually add more flour to the dough according to its age?
verses.26: If you can’t even do this minimum, then why worry about the rest?
verses.27: You understood how those accusations could lead to an increase in suffering. They didn’t cut down on it or reduce its severity. I tell you, even Solomon, in all his glory, didn’t avoid being involved in such situations at all.
verses.28: But if in the field, where today and tomorrow, the seed is placed in the furrow by God, then how much more so for you, who are so careless.
verses.29: And you shall not ask what you should eat or drink, nor be suspicious about anything.
verses.30: For all these things, all the nations of the world seek them. But your father knew that you would be the ones who would use them.
verses.31: In addition, you must also seek his kingdom. These things will be added to you.
verses.32: Do not fear, little child; it is right for your father to give you this kingdom.
verses.33: Sell what you have, and be fair in your dealings. Make sure you don’t keep anything that isn’t valuable. Store those treasures in heaven, where no thief can reach them, nor can they be destroyed.
verses.34: For where your treasures are, there also will be your hearts.
verses.35: May your flowers be in bloom, and may the tombs be filled with life.
verses.36: And you, as human beings who are destined to serve their Lord, when He comes from the marriage feast, you must immediately open the doors for Him.
verses.37: Those slaves were truly fortunate, for the Lord would soon find them. Indeed, I say to you that He will care for them and serve them after His return.
verses.38: Even if he were to enter the second or third prison, and find it in that manner, it would still be better for them to be there.
verses.39: You see therefore that if the landlord knows in advance who the thief is, he will not allow the thief to enter his house.
verses.40: And you should be prepared for the day when it no longer seems like the Son of Man will come.
verses.41: Petrus said, “Lord, are you telling us this parable, or are you telling it to everyone else as well?”
verses.42: And the Lord said, “Who then is the faithful steward, the careful one, whom the Lord will place in charge of his work of giving grain at the right time?”
verses.43: That slave was very good; the Lord found him doing such things when he came to find him.
verses.44: I truly say to you that he will be established in all those places where he exists.
verses.45: And if that slave says this in his heart… My master will say, “Come here.” Then he will start to feed the children and play with them. He will eat and drink with them.
verses.46: The master of that slave will come to him one day, neither expecting it in advance nor knowing about it at all. Then he will cut him in half, and his body will be left behind among the unbelievers.
verses.47: But that slave, who knew his master’s wishes, and who failed to prepare or carry out those wishes, will be punished severely.
verses.48: And those who do not do what is right will be punished with severe penalties. But those who have given too much will be asked for more compensation from them. And those who have given too much will be held accountable even more severely.
verses.49: We set fire to the land. What do I want now that it’s already been destroyed?
verses.50: I have already been baptized, and I don’t know how I will continue until it’s completed.
verses.51: Do you think I have created peace in this world? No, I say to you; rather, I have caused division.
verses.52: For from now on, there will be five people living in one house. Three of them will live in two rooms each, and two will live in three rooms each.
verses.53: Fathers will be separated from their sons, and sons from their fathers. Mothers will be separated from their daughters, and daughters from their mothers. Wives will be separated from their husbands, and husbands from their wives.
verses.54: He also said to the crowd: “When you see clouds rising above the mountains, immediately say that Ombros has arrived. And that’s exactly what happens.”
verses.55: And when it rises in the south, you say that it will become Kauson. And indeed, it does so.
verses.56: Fakers, you knew how to test the face of the earth and the heavens. But how could you not know how to test this time as well?
verses.57: And don’t you also judge justice independently of yourself?
verses.58: For as it is required by your judge, go before the ruler with your accuser, in order to get rid of him from his position. Do not let him take you before the judge. The judge will then hand you over to the officer, and the officer will put you in prison.
verses.59: I say to you, do not leave there until the last tiny bit is taken away as well.
